ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(uAssist_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Tech Review"), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - Rx Form needs review") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - New photos needed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - New scans needed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - New X-Rays needed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - New scans, photographs and X-Rays needed") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - Scans and images do not match") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - Please review uAssist Message") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "On Hold - New photos and Rx form review needed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change Status if set to any 'On Hold' status changes to "Tech Review"
